mapper.update: UPDATE background_job j INNER JOIN notification_delivery d ON d.enterprise_id = j.enterprise_id AND d.active_job_id = j.id SET j.status = 'cancelled', j.lease_owner = NULL, j.lease_until = NULL, j.heartbeat_at = NULL, j.error_code = d.last_error_code, j.error_summary = d.last_error_summary, j.updated_at = #{now} WHERE j.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND j.kind = 'channel_delivery' AND j.status IN ('queued', 'leased') AND d.status IN ('cancelled', 'unknown')
